items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: He's a good trumpet player. He's a member of the Eureka brass band but he don't play no more.

ctx.x: Street somewhere. Oh yeah we know. Was he with the Eureka when you first started that? Uh huh. Was he with the Eureka when you started the band? When I was with me. No he wasn't. He came brought by later? He was playing the violin and he quit playing the violin with me on the trumpet.
Whose place did he take? He's a good trumpet player. He's a member of the Eureka brass band but he don't play no more.
Whose place did he take? Huh? Whose place did he take? Who? Whose place did he take in the band?
